result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks in a residential setting. However, the lack of visible traffic control devices and the presence of parked cars near the corners create potential visibility issues and crossing risks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the crosswalks.

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are clearly visible for the approaching traffic, which may lead to confusion or failure to yield at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The street features a marked zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, but lacks signalization or traffic calming measures. Pedestrian safety is hindered by parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing and utility poles that narrow the usable sidewalk space.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles and signage posts are placed within the sidewalk path, reducing the effective width for pedestrians and those with mobility devices.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Install pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers of the unsignalized crossing.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous sidewalk in good condition along a narrow, mixed-use urban street. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and visible curb ramps, and sightlines are significantly compromised by vehicles parked close to the corner.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked near the intersection corner block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street at the intersection corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks reduces driver awareness of pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and well-maintained sidewalks on both sides of the street. However, the crossing is uncontrolled and sight lines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to manage the interaction between vehicles and pedestrians at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility.
